status: written before any pcf arm ran; measured before it: the six v1 B arms of MobileNetV3 INT8 (q1 job 1)
observation_motivating_it: All four v1 per-channel arms on MobileNetV3 INT8 are below the default (pc:kind.hardswish 69.27, pc:all 69.39, pc:role.se_product 68.33, pc:role.dw_conv 70.70 vs 71.60 top-1 expected). Their scales come from the v1 calibration samples regrouped by channel (about 400-530 samples per channel at 960-1280 channels) with the MSE search anchored at that sparse sample maximum; the screen audit shows clipping (features_16_2 loses 9.4 dB SQNR). This is a calibration defect of the v1 pc arms, not evidence against per-channel codes; the v1 pc results are reported as measured.

r3_arms.pcf_definition: pcf:TARGET = per-channel activation scales at the TARGET boundaries (same eligibility and folding as pc:), fitted by tools/experiment_b2_attrib/pcfull.py: frozen mse_search per channel on the FP32 activations of the 256 bias-correction calibration images (first 256 of the frozen calibration list), anchored at the exact per-channel max |x|, at most 4096 values per channel (every k-th value in image,row,column order). A boundary named by a pcf term is removed from the arm's affine set.
arms: affine:signed+pcf:<best of the four pcf arms on that format>
r3_arms.reserved: up to 3 further r3 arms chosen from the A1/A2 attribution, written as addendum 3 before they run

arms: the MobileNetV3 INT8 best combination where its targets exist

r3_arms.audit: all arms (occupancy and SQNR on the first 128 screen images)
r3_arms.selection_note: 'best' = highest top-1 expected on the screen (development evidence; ties by KL). The screen is used both to pick and to report the combination: its number is optimistic by construction and is labelled so.

hardware_semantics: affine: per-output-channel term z*sum(w) added to the accumulator (certified width from the B2 weight codes, closed form of tools/scaled_bridge_v2/certificates.py); per-channel: folded exactly into conv/linear consumers (weights re-quantized after folding; depthwise folds are exact per output channel), other consumers (pool, add, mul, hard-sigmoid) need per-channel requantization
gpu: low-memory path of addendum 1; at most 2 jobs running or waiting; total job wall cap unchanged (10800 s)
